mapper.insert: insert into board(board_no, title, content, member_no, created_at, delete_yn) values(seq_board.nextval, #{title}, #{content}, #{memberNo}, systimestamp, 'Y')
mapper.select: select board_no as boardNo, title, content, member_no as memberNo, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, view_count as viewCount, delete_yn as deleteYn from board where delete_yn = 'Y' order by created_at desc

select board_no as boardNo, title, content, member_no as memberNo, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, view_count as viewCount, delete_yn as deleteYn from board where board_no = #{boardNo} and delete_yn = 'Y'
